implemented: Default route opens a central creator composer for connecting data and creating a reusable Skill.
Personal and team workspace headers keep add-connection actions visible.
Connection selector is driven by the BFF connector catalog, with search, category filtering, status, capabilities, and JSON Schema fields.
Create flow collects business task, bound connections, file resources, and optional trial task before calling the real Knowledge BFF generate API.
Assistant timeline shows user messages, execution activities, tool calls, final answers, retry, cancel, and revision updates without BuildPlan or multi-stage plan UI.
Generated and published Skill views show name, description, SKILL.md, returned file list, bound connections/resources, revision metadata, trial run, edit, new revision, and publish flows.
Published Skill keeps the Assistant visible beside the selected Skill on desktop and stacks cleanly on narrow screens.
Dashboard, SOP, and Semantic appear only as disabled future Skill output types.
